cases.name: matched-catch-and-finally
cases.source:
try
    raise ArithmeticError(code = "matched")
catch err as ArithmeticError
    handled = "catch"
finally
    cleanup = "finally"

cases.name: unmatched-catch-propagates
cases.source:
try

finally

cases.name: catch-rethrow
cases.source:
try
    raise ArithmeticError(code = "main")
catch err as ArithmeticError

finally
    cleanup = "finally"

cases.name: nested-try-finally
cases.source:
try
    try
        raise ArithmeticError(code = "nested")
    catch inner as TypeError
        ignored = "wrong"
    finally
        inner_cleanup = "inner"
catch outer as ArithmeticError
    handled = "outer"
finally
    outer_cleanup = "outer"

cases.name: recursive-loop-raise-with-string-cleanup
cases.source:
def countdown(int value) -> int
    if value == 0
        return 0
    return countdown(value - 1)
result = countdown(2)
count = 0
while count < 2
    try
        count = count + 1
        if count == 2
            raise ArithmeticError(code = "loop")
    finally
        cleanup = "round"

cases.name: fatal-skips-string-cleanup
cases.source:
def down(int value) -> int
    return down(value)
try
    payload = "heap"
    result = down(1)
catch err as Error
    handled = true
finally
    cleanup = "cleanup"
